_notes: Automation data for the Iconic Weapons chapter; every item's text is its entry in Corgo's document. `weapons` and `variants` hold, per heading, stat overrides under `rec` (the way text/weapon_variants.json does) and extra Foundry `notes`; an Iconic with nothing to override needs no entry here. Iconics carry Category and Fabrication instead of a Cost; the builder maps the category to that tier's eurodollar benchmark.

notes: Corgo's starting stats: 20 round Capacity, 3d6 damage, 1 SP Ablation. The weapon re-rolls all three on every Reload (1d20 Capacity, 1d8 damage dice, 1d4 SP Ablation), which the sheet cannot do, so edit the item's damage and magazine by hand after each Reload.
Single Shot expends 2 rounds, and its Critical Injury roll is 1d12 rather than 2d6. Neither is automated.
Corgo gives no stat line for this one, only "Two-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon", so it uses CPR 0.92.4's generic Very Heavy Melee Weapon: 4d6, ROF 2, two-handed.
